subject: Atlas demo recording + slides — quick 15m Q&A?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@atlas-analytics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Atlas demo recording + slides — quick 15m Q&A?

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time to meet earlier this week — really enjoyed learning about Atlas's search & insights roadmap. Per our call, I recorded the demo and pulled together the slide deck so your team can share internally: 

- Recording: https://drive.google.com/file/d/recording123
- Slides (attached): Atlas-demo-slides.pdf

Quick recap / next steps I captured:
- Primary use case: semantic search on historical product docs + routing to support agents.
- Key success metrics: 90th pct latency under 300ms for search queries; 40% reduction in time-to-first-answer for support reps.
- Data & security: VPC/private deployment preferred for PII-heavy logs; SOC2 evidence requests next (happy to loop in our security team).

If it’s helpful, I can set up a short 15-minute Q&A with Rishi (our solutions engineer) to walk through the recording and answer any technical or deployment questions. Two options I have next week:
- Tue Apr 5, 11:00–11:15 AM PT
- Wed Apr 6, 2:00–2:15 PM PT

If those don't work, tell me a couple of times that do and I’ll make it happen. Also happy to share a brief mutual action plan if you want to map procurement/PO timing.

Cheers,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0147

--
Attachment: Atlas-demo-slides.pdf (PDF, 12 slides)
